title: Implicit Joins (Arrow Syntax) | Using SQL | InterSystems IRIS Data Platform 2026.1

examples.sql: SELECT Sample.Employee.Name, Sample.Company.Name AS CompName FROM Sample.Employee LEFT OUTER JOIN Sample.Company ON Sample.Employee.Company = Sample.Company.ID
SELECT Name, Company->Name AS CompName FROM Sample.Employee
SELECT Name,Company AS CompID,Company->Name AS CompName FROM Sample.Employee WHERE Company->Name %STARTSWITH 'G'
SELECT E.Name,E.Company AS CompID,C.Name AS CompName FROM Sample.Employee AS E, Sample.Company AS C WHERE E.Company = C.ID AND C.Name %STARTSWITH 'G'
SELECT Name,Spouse,Home_State,Office_State,Spouse->Home_State AS SpouseState FROM Sample.Employee WHERE Home_State=Spouse->Home_State OR Office_State=Spouse->Home_State
SELECT Name,Company->Name AS CompName FROM Sample.Employee GROUP BY Company->Name
SELECT Name,Company->Name AS CompName FROM Sample.Employee ORDER BY Company->Name
SELECT Name,Company->Name AS CompName FROM Sample.Employee ORDER BY CompName
SELECT ReviewScore,Film,Film->Title,Film->Category,Film->Category->CategoryName FROM Cinema.Review ORDER BY ReviewScore
SELECT L.amount FROM Orders O LEFT JOIN LineItems L ON O.id=L.custorder
SELECT Name,Company->Name AS CompanyName FROM Sample.Employee GROUP BY Company->Name ORDER BY Company->Name
